name: Inbox Triage
description: Clean up Outlook inbox clutter with a review-first triage plan that groups newsletters, notifications, old meeting mail, resolved threads, and duplicates - approved per bucket, moved (never deleted) to folders you can restore from.
author: Jagmeet Chabra (Microsoft)
coverImageAlt: Blank envelopes sorted into navy trays beside a protected clear cradle.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: a calm reversible sorting metaphor in which unmarked sealed envelopes are gently organized into a small set of open archival trays while a few important envelopes remain protected inside a clear cradle, expressing review-first inbox triage without deletion
Scene/backdrop: uncluttered slate work surface with warm paper planes and quiet architectural depth
Subject: tactile blank envelopes, orderly shallow trays, and one transparent protective cradle; all surfaces completely free of writing, stamps, symbols, or glyph-like marks
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%; strong silhouette and calm negative space; legible at small card size
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical, with restrained cyan backlighting and a tiny orange highlight
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, symbols, stamps, labels, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI or Microsoft Fluent branding; no deletion or trash imagery
